text: Code refactoring is the process of improving the structure of existing code without changing what it does. When developers refactor, they reorganize and clean up their code to make it easier to read and understand. This does not affect how the program behaves for users. Good refactoring helps reduce technical debt, which builds up over time when code is written quickly or poorly. By keeping code clean and well organized, teams can find and fix bugs more easily, add new features faster, and work together more effectively. In short, refactoring makes software healthier without changing its behavior.
